rules.title: Interactive controls have keyboard semantics
exceptions: Use links for navigation and buttons for actions; specialized widgets follow their own keyboard model.
rules.repair: Use native semantics; test activation, names and disabled states.

rules.title: Retain edits and report persistence truthfully
rules.applicability: Forms that save through an asynchronous service.
exceptions: A queued write may say queued, never persisted; explicit discard may clear data.
rules.repair: Keep draft and committed data separate; reject stale responses; retry rejected writes without clearing input.

rules.title: Errors identify and link to the relevant field
exceptions: A summary is a contextual implementation, not itself a WCAG requirement; sensitive error detail may be withheld.
rules.repair: Use one error model for inline messages and summary links; preserve valid description IDs and focus the linked control.

rules.title: Choose validation and unsaved-work policy deliberately
rules.applicability: Editing and attempted cancellation or navigation.
exceptions: Do not block navigation for pristine forms; autosave requires its own truthful operation model.
rules.repair: Document submit/blur timing and connect requestLeave to cancel, router Back and navigation; explain browser unload limits.
verification: manual: exercise cancel, Back, reload and route change with unsaved data

rules.title: Distinguish collection states and retain identity
exceptions: First-use empty and no-results apply only when the application knows the distinction; offline/cache may add states.
rules.repair: Render loading, refreshing, empty, filtered empty and failure accurately; use stable keys and an explicit selection policy.

rules.title: Confirm intent separately from operation completion
exceptions: Direct actions are suitable when real recovery exists; confirmation is not universal.
rules.repair: Name target and consequence; delay success until execute resolves; wire real undo or appropriate review, and logical focus.

rules.title: Allow correction and preserve a truthful receipt
rules.applicability: Processes with a review step before final commitment.
exceptions: Not every short form needs a separate review screen; redundant-entry and error-prevention criteria have scoped exceptions.
rules.repair: Retain applicable answers through correction and failed submission; show a service-issued receipt and a durable destination.

rules.title: Status is perceivable without moving focus unnecessarily
rules.applicability: Status messages that do not receive focus.
exceptions: Urgent errors may use alerts; avoid announcing every keystroke or repeated decorative status.
rules.repair: Use an appropriate live region and concise meaningful messages; test feedback with assistive technology.

rules.title: Height has an equivalent non-depth signal
exceptions: Decorative depth carries no required semantic meaning.
rules.repair: Pair depth with text, state or border and inspect forced colors/reduced motion.
verification: manual: forced colors, reduced motion, zoom and RTL review

rules.title: Hold-to-confirm remains a scoped hypothesis
rules.applicability: Considering hold gestures for consequential actions.
exceptions: Never require a hold as the sole accessible way to complete a task.
rules.repair: Choose review or real recovery from task consequences; evaluate hold benefits with representative users.

rules.title: Installed guidance and setup versions agree
rules.applicability: Projects using the explicit CLI adapter.
exceptions: Projects may read local guidance directly without configuring an agent.
rules.repair: Reinstall/build the matching package and rerun altitude init for configured clients.

rules.title: One primary action per view
rules.applicability: Any view: a page, and each Dialog, Sheet and Popover. Independent parts (cards on a dashboard) can be scoped with PrimaryScope.
exceptions: A dashboard of independent cards, each with its own task, wrapped in PrimaryScope.
rules.repair: Keep one Button variant="primary" per view (PageHeader's primary slot on a page); make the rest secondary or ghost, or put them in an overflow menu.

rules.title: Persistent states don't rise
rules.applicability: States that feel important but persist: unread, invited (awaiting someone else), recommended or most popular, current plan or item, locked behind a plan, an app-wide mode, proposed by an agent, streaming text.
exceptions: A state that is live right now (a write in flight, something in a hand, an action being asked for) uses its own signal from Elevation.md.
rules.repair: Say the state in words, a plate, a dot, weight or an ARIA state, and keep the thing at its own level: unread is a dot and weight 600; invited is a plate, not pending; recommended is a plate with only its CTA at level 2; current is the word and aria-current; locked stays live and opens the upgrade; a mode is a strip and a viewport border; an agent's proposal is raised, asking; streaming text stays on the ground and settles once. See Elevation.md, "States that don't rise".
verification: manual:review the screen against Elevation.md, "States that don't rise"

rules.title: Each settings section applies now or saves together, and destructive actions sit in a final danger zone
rules.applicability: Settings pages that combine standalone preferences, records saved together and destructive actions.
exceptions: A page with only one mode needs only that mode; a single destructive action outside settings follows the consequential-action contract alone.
rules.repair: Give each section one mode: apply-now controls report their own write (pending, committed, failed with the control restored); fields that form one record join one draft saved once. Move delete, transfer and similar actions to a final section titled Danger zone, at the same height as the others, each named by its outcome with its consequence in words.

rules.title: Invitations are settled records, and guards are said where the action would be
rules.applicability: Member lists with invitations, roles and removal.
exceptions: Products without invitations or roles apply only the guard requirement.
rules.repair: Draw an invitation awaiting acceptance on the ground with an Invited plate, its role and sent date; hover only while sending. Replace an action a person may not take (removing the last owner, demoting yourself out of the last admin role) with the reason in words, and enforce the same guard on the server.

rules.title: Usage is a reading, a plan change is reviewed with its cost, and a downgrade lists what's lost
rules.applicability: Billing pages with usage limits and plan changes.
exceptions: Prices and proration are the billing service's; the interface shows what the service quotes and never computes a charge itself.
rules.repair: Draw each quota as a Meter with its state in words, never Progress; mark the rest of the cycle as projected; review a plan change with the quoted proration as a sentence before confirming, and claim it only after the service confirms; list what a downgrade removes and name its button by the outcome.

rules.title: Auth copy reveals nothing, fields carry autocomplete tokens, and nothing is submitted for the person
rules.applicability: Sign-in, sign-up, verification, two-factor and reset screens.
exceptions: Products that delegate authentication to a hosted provider apply this to the parts they render.
rules.repair: Use responses that hold whether or not the account exists; state rate limits with the wait; give every field its autocomplete token and allow paste; keep Verify and Sign in as buttons the person presses; keep the email across steps; offer a path that isn't a cognitive test.

rules.title: Audit entries are flush sentences that expand to their change, and export is a job
exceptions: Entries that link somewhere may lift when pointed at; nothing else does.
rules.repair: Render each entry as a flush row that reads as one sentence with its actor, exact time and origin; expand it to the before and after; keep the workspace log and a record's feed apart; run export as a task with progress, then offer the download and log the export.

rules.title: Mapping shows what's left, invalid cells sink with their problem, and the import ends with a receipt
rules.applicability: File imports with mapping and row validation.
exceptions: Imports with a fixed format skip mapping; the fix, review and receipt still apply.
rules.repair: Give each source column a Select that fills when mapped and list unmapped required fields in words; show invalid cells as trenches with their problem in the cell's description and announce the count as it changes; review in one sentence of consequences; run the import as a job with progress, cancellation where supported, and a receipt of imported, skipped and failed rows.
